kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: A right-click on a cell (L358), or Shift+F10 or the Menu key on the selected level (PROPOSED until a keymap entry exists, GAP-12; L359), opens the CMP-041 cell menu: QA R5's six items (L357-358), drawn once E40 registers its alert flow (L366-367; GAP-16).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Frame: a Viewer on 13:35's 64,011.0, a buy flag (228 / 38 = 6.0): Create alert, Add note, Horizontal line and Replay T2 (L361-364); Focus imbalance and Copy level as TSV enabled (L366). Inset 1: 13:30's 64,011.0, no flag: Focus imbalance T2 (L361). Inset 2: offline, board 30's frozen frame: those four T2 (L364-366).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: QA R5 (L126): six items, one wording on SCR-030 / 045 / 056, never an order (L368), T2; carry n3 (L130). §6.5's T2 (G-T2). Base frame (board 01's): D1–D6, D15, D16. A-1, A-30, A-37, A-38; GAP-12, GAP-16; OQ-10.

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Permissions come from the session, never the role name; the server refuses regardless: 403 and an audit record (§6.5 L606-607). Frame: the Viewer lacks alerts:write, journal:write, workspaces:write and replay:write (L362-364), each leg in CMP-079 RbacGate with the CMP-019 lock. Insets: a session holding all four, as permission comes before a state (L612).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Plot stop (§8.1 L721-724): ↑ / ↓ select a level (L731); Shift+F10 or the Menu key opens the menu (PROPOSED: no keymap entry yet, GAP-12; L734). ↑ / ↓ land on all six, T2 items too (aria-disabled; L608-609). Enter / Space run an enabled item; on a T2 item they change nothing and re-show the reason (L610-611). Esc closes, focus back on the level (L359, L735).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: The first enabled item, ringed (L359): Focus imbalance in the frame and inset 2, Create alert at this level in inset 1. The level box (§8.1 L740) stays as the anchor; no full stack label, as focus is in the menu (§4.4 L292-293).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Polite (E06-D03 D5). Open: the menu (§8.1 L734), focus on its first enabled item (L359). A T2 item: its name, 'unavailable', then the reason (E09-D09 §2.2); Enter / Space on it: the reason once (L610-612; E17-D01 D13). The menu's own name is not given (copy gap).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Kit copy ids (not spec keys): menu.focus, menu.alert, menu.note, menu.hline, menu.replay, menu.copy (L357-358); why.alerts, why.journal, why.workspaces, why.replay = rbac.permission (L361-364); why.no_imbalance, a PROPOSED state key for E18-D05 (L361; §6.5 L613); why.offline, PROPOSED for E17-D01's vocabulary (L364-365; L614).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: SYNTHETIC (QA G8): board 01's scene, 10 bars × 40 rows of 10 ticks, §4.1's hand-picked rows (L220-224) over footprint.mjs. Focus imbalance from the level's FootprintImbalance flag (memo R5); the four from the session (`14` §0.5 rule 5); offline from E17-D01's feed state. copy_gaps: The cell menu's accessible name is not given: §8.1 L734 announces 'the menu' (→ E18-D05; E18-D04 owns the announcement policy table, §16 L936).
Spec gap: no event is named for opening the cell menu or choosing an item (§4.8 L355-373); each item's flow owns its event (E40's alert, the journal, E14's drawing events, SCR-098) (→ E18-D05).
Create alert's reason: §4.8 L362 uses E09-D09's "Your role can't change alerts." against E11-D04 §9's "your role can't create alerts" (OQ-10 L929, open): drawn as L362 writes it.

"No imbalance at this level." (a PROPOSED state key, memo R5; L361) and "Offline — this needs the server." (PROPOSED for E17-D01's vocabulary; L364-365) are unregistered until E18-D05 and E17-D01's owner take them (§16 L937; §6.5 L612-614).

Spec gap: which feed states make the four T2 is not stated beyond 'offline' (L364): drawn at E17-D01's offline state, chip 'Offline — retry stopped' (§5 L400); whether 'Reconnecting (3)' gates them too is open (→ E18-D05, E17-D01's owner).

Spec gap: whether a right-click reaches a cell under the disconnected DOM scrim (E11-D02 D16) is not stated: inset 2 shows the keyboard route (Shift+F10 on the selected level, PROPOSED, GAP-12; §8.1 L734).

Spec gap: Shift+F10 and the Menu key have no keymap row, on the selected level or a mirror level: PROPOSED until one lands, and `14`'s SCR-030 hotkeys line leaves them out meanwhile (§4.8 L359; §8.1 L734, L742-743; A-1 L853; GAP-12 L907).

Spec gap: how the cell menu reflows at 200 % zoom or the in-app text scale is not stated (§4.8; `05` §5 item 7): not drawn here (→ E18-D02 §4.8, a carry on PR #4180, or CMP-041's owner, E11-D05 #310).

Spec gap: whether the stack's full label stays while the menu is open on a stack level is not stated (§4.4 L292-293: hover, keyboard focus of a stack level, Focus imbalance, a locate); with focus in the menu it is not drawn, and beside 13:35 it has no free space (18 px) to sit in.
Spec gap: 'Create alert at this level' has no chart source until E40 registers one (GAP-16 L911): the board draws the menu after it registers (L366-367); before that the item is absent (E11-D04 D10).

The pressed cluster segment reads 'Live' in E11-D02 §7.2 (L267; owner question O-E, 'Live' or 'Following', L819), while §4.1's sketch writes 'auto' (L227): the board keeps 'auto'; the owner settles the word via E11-D03 (O-E).

D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 mark the forming bar with the cap and the word 'forming' in the legend, but §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no such word and §4.1's sketch (L218) shows none: the legend reads 'FP Bid × Ask · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (kit legend_text). Carry for E18-D05 (to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): a legend '· forming' while the newest or cursor bar forms (D7 L157, §8.3 L763 against §4.9 L380-382); the boards draw it once settled.
